title: Verify that Query Field should be auto populate in data stream in non editable field.
preconditions:
1.User should be on the home page of FMS.
2.Column configuration should be done already.

steps.expectedResult: Data Source Configuration list page should be open
Add Data Source page should be open

steps.testData:
Data Source - Test
MongoDB TableName - Test
Data Source Type :- Usage or Subscription

steps.action: Select the Fields from the drop down
Select the Query Field from the drop down (Single selection)
Go to Extraction & Load Layer -> Data Stream Configuration
steps.expectedResult: Data stream list page should be open
Data stream Master page should open

steps.action: Select the data source which configured above
steps.expectedResult: Query Field should be auto populate  in non editable field.
